units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 106a:5">Snh. 106ᵃ</cite> <he>אוי לה לאומה … עושה פ׳ לבניו</he> woe to the nation that is found (to interfere), when the Lord prepares delivery for his children.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 1:6">Bekh. I, 6</cite> <he>פ׳ פטר חמור</he> the animal designated as ransom for the first-born of an ass (<cite ref="Exodus 13:13">Ex. XIII, 13</cite>).

<cite ref="Exodus 13:13">Ib.</cite> <he>פ׳ מעשר שני</he> the redemption money for the second tithes. Ib. II, 1 <he>פ׳ הבן</he> the redemption of the first-born son. Ib. 2, <he>לאחר פִּדְיוֹנָן</he> after they have been redeemed.
<cite ref="Chullin 7a:10">Ḥull. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>פ׳ שבויין</he> the ransom of captives; a. fr.—[<he>בר פדיון</he>, v. <cite ref="Q00120"><he>פְּדָיָה</he></cite>.]
